answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the pearl of a task receipt, and the forge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The terrace of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
